title: Indigenous Agro-Ecological Systems of South India
author: Dr. R. Ananthakrishnan
content: Traditional seed priming in Tamil agro-ecosystems involved cow urine soaking followed by specialized microbial soil enrobing. In coastal saline tracts, farmers conditioned native varieties like Navara with progressive salinity exposure. Storage vessels (Kudhuru) were lined with hot castor oil and sealed with wood ash and dry turmeric dust to deter grain borers.
